concerns.text: The plan proposes Wilcoxon signed‑rank tests on F1‑scores across only five random seeds (FR‑006). With n = 5 paired observations the smallest attainable two‑sided p‑value is ≈0.0625, which can never meet the declared FDR < 0.05 threshold after Benjamini‑Hochberg correction (SC‑003). This makes the statistical significance claim untestable given the current sample size.

Node‑level anomaly labels are defined as “1 if the IP appears in any anomalous flow within the scenario” (research.md & data‑model.md). The plan does not restrict this aggregation to the training portion of the temporal hold‑out split, risking leakage of test‑set information into the training labels. If test‑set flows contribute to node labels, the evaluation metrics (Precision, Recall, F1, AUC) are no longer independent of the predictors, violating proper validation practice.
